|rulings=* This does ''not'' circumvent restrictions listed on an Objective (even if the Objective references limiting deployment at certain locations).<ref name="scomp">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Players Committee card data], pinned <code>d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab</code>, <code>6_142</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. Archived source page: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* This does ''not'' circumvent text on a card that says it only deploys if a certain Objective on table.
* This does ''not'' circumvent rules or text that certain cards cannot ''exist'' at certain locations (e.g. no starfighters at [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]] or [[Endor: Dense Forest (Dark){{!}}Endor: Dense Forest]]).
* This does ''not'' circumvent deployment restriction text that is entirely unrelated to locations (e.g. [[Emperor's Orders]] or [[Revenge Of The Sith]]).
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of presence or Force icons.
* Allows cards to deploy to [[Dagobah (Dark){{!}}Dagobah]] or [[Ahch-To]].
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of their own game text saying they can only deploy to certain locations.
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of game text on other cards (except Objectives) saying certain cards may not deploy to certain locations.
* If deployed on a non-shielded location (e.g. [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark){{!}}Hoth: Defensive Perimeter]]) and then that location becomes shielded later, [[Cane Adiss]] remains there and will allow cards to deploy there regardless of the shield.

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:JP-D-caneadiss-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Cane Adiss (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): Same words as the previous version. Another full card image (350 × 490 pixels): the text box is set again, and a small round bronze disc at the lower right replaces the white “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
